audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Vayne in six of seven rows (row 4 Skill). The already-audited Cho'Gath side settled this chart as Skill / Vayne / Skill / Skill / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Vayne with ratings 5,4,5,5,6,6,3 from their perspective. Left as-is the two pages would tell a reader opposite things about levels 1, 3, 4-5, 6 and first item.
audit.why: The mirror is the binding side here and tools/mirror-fix.js would overwrite any disagreement I introduced. Restated from Vayne's perspective the same chart is Skill / Vayne / Skill / Skill / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Vayne with the inverse ratings 5,6,5,5,4,4,7. It is also the more honest read: Feast at 6 and his health item land before Blade of the Ruined King completes, and Vayne's 54.67% comes from the two-item window, not from owning level 1.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side and win[0] = Skill (5/10); phases[2] and win[2] = Skill (5/10); phases[3] and win[3] = Skill (5/10); phases[4] and win[4] = Cho'Gath (4/10); phases[5] and win[5] = Cho'Gath (4/10); phases[6] and win[6] = Vayne (7/10). Row 1 stays Vayne, raised to 6/10 to match the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike ordering had Vayne owning first item, which is backwards: Cho'Gath's health item completes before Blade of the Ruined King and Feast starts stacking at 6. No cooldowns were attached to any of it.
audit.why: Rupture is 6s flat, Feral Scream 11/10.5/10/9.5/9s, Vorpal Spikes 8/7/6/5/4s, Feast 80/70/60s. Vayne's answers are Tumble at 6s rank 1, Condemn at 20s, Final Hour at 100s. The lane is Cho's from 6 through his first item and Vayne's on two items.
audit.corrected: Feast 80s at rank 1 stated in phases[4].why; Rupture's 6s flat used in phases[3].why as the reason his walk-up window recurs fast; first-item stage handed to Cho'Gath in phases[5], win[5] and spikes[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions the mirror verified were missing from this side: Rupture's 950 range sits far outside Condemn's 550, so 'engage when Rupture is down' was advice you cannot execute at his range; and Feral Scream's silence denies BOTH Tumble and Condemn, which the page never said despite listing 'Get silenced' as a mistake. wants.foe[0] also says Rupture 'knocks you up and root' — it knocks up and slows, there is no root.
audit.why: Feast is true damage, so armour and MR do not save you from it — the only defence is staying above its line. The silence is what makes his combo work: without Tumble you cannot dodge the follow-up, so the Scream cooldown, not the Rupture cooldown, is the real gate on walking up.
audit.corrected: Rupture 950 range, knock-up and slow, no root; Feral Scream at 300 range silences and denies Tumble and Condemn; Feast is true damage through your resistances; Silver Bolts' third hit is percent-max-health true damage and stacks on attacks AND abilities.

audit.why: The mirror flagged that chogath.json tags Rupture with a grounding flag purely because Riot's text contains the word 'ground'. Riot's description is a knock-up and slow with no grounding, so I asserted only the knock-up and did not write any grounding claim on this side either.
